correctness.rationale: The theorem defines S_T(k)=Σ_{|U|=k} max-component-order(T[U]) and F_T(p)=Σ S_T(k)p^k(1-p)^(n−k), including the empty subset and p endpoints. Independent networkx nonisomorphic-tree enumeration gave class counts 1,1,1,2,3,6,11,23, exact same-degree nonisomorphic pair counts 0,0,0,0,0,1,5,23, and precisely one coordinatewise-incomparable pair at n=8, none earlier. The exceptional pair has signed fixed-size difference only at k=5,6, yielding the all-real-p polynomial p^5(1-p)^2(2p−1) with orientation as RESULT.md. Recursive leaf extension and complete rooted-word invariant prove exhaustive coverage; direct subset enumeration is exhaustive only through n=8. No claim for larger trees follows.
residual_risks: Comparison is limited to equal-sized independent retention on trees, same degree multiset, n≤8; n>8 not enumerated.
